Full 13-service catalog advertised, with exact per-image installed availability sets
Base 4; AI Toolkit 8; LTX 7; musubi 7; captioning variants add vllm
train_audio defaults true and preserves explicit false in installed RunConfig
Installed catalog SHA256 matches reviewed pod source
All 13 services advertise supports_hf_token derived from the installed schema; expected 11 true and two false
Fresh hf_token overrides stale environment for vllm, draw, generation and upscale; public params and fake argv redact it

archive.method: git archive exact commit; task-local Dockerfile replaces only agent and repository program files on digest-pinned unchanged GPU runtimes

buildMethod: Fresh base; replace complete agent environment and source trees plus repository program files on digest-pinned existing GPU runtime images. Unchanged trainer/CUDA/SeedVR2/vLLM layers reused without reinstall.
oldAgentLayerOverhead: Prior agent layer remains in inherited runtime layers; its environment and source trees are deleted before copying fresh replacements, so old packages and removed files cannot execute.
captioningLayerReuse: Existing immutable captioning runtime parents retain identical vLLM bytes; the new flag checker verifies the installed vLLM before publication.
